name: hippo
description: Local, git-native memory for Claude Code — your repo is the store, recall is $0/prompt (no LLM, no network), staleness is git-drift (the cited code moved), and team memory ships through review.

calm_session_start.title: Calm SessionStart
calm_session_start.description: Open each session with a short digest (integrity warnings, where you left off, one next step, a count of queued maintenance) instead of the full report. HIPPO_ATTENTION=calm or full overrides it.

capture_llm.title: LLM triage of captured sessions
capture_llm.description: Opt in to one small-model call when a session ends, suggesting a type and description for its pending capture. Suggestions only; you still approve every memory. Needs the LLM API key below. HIPPO_CAPTURE_LLM overrides it.

dream_contradictions.title: LLM contradiction check in dream
dream_contradictions.description: Opt in to a small-model check of strongly related memory pairs during a dream pass run through hippo's MCP tool; conflicts go to the resolve inbox, never applied. Needs the LLM API key below. HIPPO_DREAM_CONTRADICTIONS overrides it.

dream_generative.title: Dream drafts tier
dream_generative.description: Let dream passes run through hippo's MCP tool stage draft schema memories (flagged, self-expiring, no LLM). HIPPO_DREAM_GENERATIVE overrides it.

llm_model.title: LLM model
llm_model.description: Model id for the opt-in LLM passes. Leave empty for hippo's default small model. HIPPO_LLM_MODEL overrides it.

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key
llm_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for the opt-in LLM passes, kept in your system keychain. It reaches hippo's hooks and MCP server only, never a shell command. HIPPO_LLM_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY override it.
